metadata.description: Cadjitsu: parametric CAD for 3D-printable parts. The plugin connects agents to Cadjitsu's MCP server and teaches them to model printable parts.

plugins.name: cadjitsu
plugins.description: Design 3D-printable parts in Cadjitsu from Claude: sketch, extrude, fillet, drill, combine, change parameters and export a checked STL or STEP through Cadjitsu's MCP server.
